turns.assessment: The event is a simultaneous, all-channel hard optical loss in the S19→S10 direction at about t=600 s. Input and output power were lost even at the S19 booster, while the reverse S10→S19 OMS remained unchanged and amplifier pump currents did not change. This localizes the failure ahead of the S19→S10 booster, most strongly to the OMS input patch at S19; downstream amplifier, span, and individual channel faults do not fit.

proposals.rationale: A disconnected or broken OMS input patch at S19 would remove all channels at the booster input and consequently at every downstream amplifier and S10 receiver. This exactly matches the hard directional loss, unchanged reverse direction, and unchanged pump currents.

A failed S19 WSS port could also block the complete set of channels feeding the S19→S10 degree and leave the booster without optical input, but the direct OMS-input localization favors the patch connection.
